requirements: Is there exactly one full-body painting of Boppy alone?
Is Boppy standing and facing the viewer at a slight three-quarter angle turned toward the left?
Is Boppy's head tipped slightly forward with eyes looking toward the left?
Are both of Boppy's hands loosely clasped in front at the waist?
Is Boppy's mouth closed in a small attentive smile?
Does Boppy have an interested and warm expression?
Does the figure fill about 85 percent of the picture height and appear centered?
Is the head size and body proportions consistent with the approved talking sheet?
Are the face, hair, build, age, clothes and colors exactly as in the approved hero painting?
